title: I Saved His Life, But He Chose My Best Friend
description: I nearly died saving a wounded snake, nursed him back to health, and gave him my whole heart. But the second he took human form, he looked right past me and chose my best friend instead. Now, I'm done playing the quiet savior—it's time to show them both what happens when you cross the wrong person.
